issue.title: Fix refcnt exception
issue.body:
This can happen if the stream is used after an exception is thrown.

Fixes #22263

body:
I think this maybe the pattern then.

1. We call outputStream.write(bs) to write byte[] of one record
2. That threw java.io.IOException: io.vertx.core.VertxException: Connection was closed
3. We catch that and turn that into a new RuntimeException(e)
4. Our higher level catches that and abandons further reads/writes BUT we have the following code in a finally clause
5. writeStream(outputStream, "]".getBytes()) This is because our streams of records are always Json arrays so we have to manually add the closing bracket to make valid Json array.  So we do make this one final write after an exception.

Does your commit above allow this now?  I think we want to send this to client else they will have a garbage Json response.  Yes it's incomplete if exception but would be worse to have bad Json also.

Also what is causing the io.vertx.core.VertxException that starts this chain of events?

That would do it. The original exception is because the connection has failed (e.g. the user closed the browser), once you have one failed write all subsequent writes will also fail, so writing the closing bracket will have no effect.
With my commit you will just get a more explicit 'stream is closed' exception.

Okay yes I agree if the user initiated the close then all this is on them and not server errors at all but how can I know definitively the user broke the connection?  E.g. how can I know why 'stream is closed'?  Will your change effect the original VertxException or the second IllegalReferenceCountException?  Ideally I'd like to know definitively on the first if the user initiated the close so I could abort further DB reads and writes and not clog up the logs with all these non-server errors.

When you get the first exception you know the connection is broken. There is no real way to know who initiated it (short of looking at the message text and making a guess), but the important point is that from that point on you are not going to be able to send any more data.
@dhoffer it won't help you there but for the record we are now publishing the universe bom for CRs too.
